8,354 likes, 228 comments - besteverfoodreviewshow on October 19, 2026: "Eating Food in Europe’s Whitest Country! 🇵🇱🥟

Full YouTube Video Title
I Found the World’s WHITEST Food!!

Featuring:
Best Ever Food Review Show Host, Sonny Side
Local Polish Co-Hosts, Karolina Klesta & Bartosz Zdeb
@polish_foodies @rediscoveringpoland @barykrakow @podbaranem

🇵🇱 Kraków, POLAND
🥫 EXPLORING POLISH CUISINE!!

Featured Food:
Pierogi Ruskie (potato and cheese dumplings with fruit/onion toppings), Gołąbki (stuffed cabbage rolls in tomato sauce), Kotlet Mielony (minced meat patties with potatoes), Chłodnik (cold beetroot soup with beef, eggs, and dill), Kasza Gryczana (buckwheat groats), Grasica Cielęca (veal sweetbreads in cream and white wine sauce with pastry), Pieczeń z Sarny (old Polish style roasted venison with potato pancakes and beets), Oscypek (smoked sheep’s milk cheese), Jagnię Pieczone w Ziemi (pit-roasted lamb with herbs and potatoes), Tarcioki (potato dumplings with bacon), and Kwaśnica (sauerkraut soup with smoked pork ribs, mushrooms, buttermilk, and oscypek).

Shoutout to our Local Production Team!
Marcin Krasnowolski (Local Fixer) @krayasny
Maciej Orlik (Production Assistant)

#BEFRS #BestEverFoodReviewShow #BestEverPolandFoodTour 🇵🇱".
